### Solomon's Wise Request
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/solomons-wise-request
Passage: 1 Kings 3:9
Points:
- Solomon recognized his inadequacy to rule justly without receiving divine guidance from above.
- Rather than pursuing personal glory or riches, he humbly asked for moral discernment.
- God was pleased with his selfless prayer and granted him wisdom along with honor and wealth.
- Prioritizing God's wisdom mirrors Christ's instruction to seek first the kingdom of God.
- Believers must continually persevere in God's wisdom by reading and hearing His Word.

### Why We Should Ask for Wisdom
Author: Emma Danzey
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/faith/spiritual-life/why-we-should-ask-for-wisdom.html
Passage: 1 Kings 3:5
Points:
- Presented with an open invitation from God, Solomon unselfishly chose discernment over worldly advantage.
- Asking for discernment pleases the Lord and protects a leader from making foolish choices.
- God often adds further blessings to those who prioritize spiritual understanding over selfish ambition.
- Believers can boldly ask God for wisdom because He delights in answering that request.
- Growing in wisdom requires daily engagement with Scripture, prayer, and godly counselors.

### 3 Lessons from Solomon's Prayer That Can Give Us Spiritual Wisdom
Author: Whitney Hopler
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/faith/prayer/lessons-from-solomons-prayer-for-wisdom.html
Passage: 1 Kings 3:1-15
Points:
- True wisdom surpasses mere factual knowledge by enabling believers to make righteous decisions.
- Pursuing godly discernment holds far greater eternal value than chasing temporary earthly gains.
- Recognizing the wonder of God's work inspires believers to cultivate a deeper reverence for Him.
- Humble prayers for discernment open the heart to receive God's generous direction and guidance.
